name: MTA:SA 1.7 Custom
author: tomika901
description: Custom MTA:SA 1.7 x64 Pterodactyl egg. Requires the local mtasa17-pterodactyl:latest runtime image and mtasa17-custom-installer:latest installer image from the supplied server bundle.

config.startup: {"done":"Server started and is ready to accept connections!"}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

echo "======================================"
echo " Custom MTA:SA 1.7 installation"
echo "======================================"

if [ ! -x /opt/mtasa/mta-server64 ] || [ ! -d /opt/mtasa/x64 ]; then
    echo "ERROR: Wrong or missing installer image."
    echo "Expected: mtasa17-custom-installer:latest"
    exit 20
fi

mkdir -p /mnt/server

# A custom engine minden reinstallnál frissül.
rm -rf /mnt/server/x64
cp -a /opt/mtasa/x64 /mnt/server/

cp -af /opt/mtasa/mta-server64 /mnt/server/mta-server64
chmod +x /mnt/server/mta-server64

# Root szintű szükséges fájlok frissítése.
find /opt/mtasa -maxdepth 1 -type f \
    ! -name 'mta-server64' \
    -exec cp -af {} /mnt/server/ \;

# Configok és resource-ok:
# meglévő saját fájlokat nem írjuk felül.
mkdir -p /mnt/server/mods/deathmatch
cp -an /opt/mtasa/mods/deathmatch/. /mnt/server/mods/deathmatch/

# A custom kliens miatt ne kényszerítsen stock MTA frissítést.
CONF="/mnt/server/mods/deathmatch/mtaserver.conf"
if [ -f "$CONF" ]; then
    sed -i \
      -e 's#<minclientversion>.*</minclientversion>#<minclientversion></minclientversion>#' \
      -e 's#<minclientversion_auto_update>.*</minclientversion_auto_update>#<minclientversion_auto_update>0</minclientversion_auto_update>#' \
      -e 's#<recommendedclientversion>.*</recommendedclientversion>#<recommendedclientversion></recommendedclientversion>#' \
      "$CONF"
fi

echo "======================================"
echo " Installation complete"
echo " Runtime: mtasa17-pterodactyl:latest"
echo "======================================"
